messages:
kate: kicking off a small v2 experiment in the 11:00 UTC change window. plan: 25% -> 10m -> 50% -> hold 20m. need quick agreement on rollback triggers and client pin updates.

mike: heads-up: some older clients still send `X-Client-Version: 1.0` with mixed-case header. v2 rejects strict casing. can we enable gateway-case-normalize as a temporary shim?

ops_jordan: gating metrics: if 5xx rate > 0.4% sustained over 2m OR error budget burn > 5% in 5m -> trigger rollback. also, if p95 latency > 700ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> rollback.

samir: prefer EU-only canary for first 5m, then global. mobile cohort should be pinned until we confirm streaming stable. add them to the pinlist.

deploybot: ACTION SCHEDULED by kate at 2025-04-08T11:00:00Z: route-toggle /api -> v2
monitor_id: ml-1725559999

anya: checklist: release notes update (callouts for header handling), add telemetry label `rollout:ml-1725559999`, create eval set and capture errors to s3://rollouts/ml-1725559999/errors.

mike: i can deploy gateway-case-normalize toggle in edge-proxy. patch applied to staging, smoke ok. faster than changing v2 code path.

kate: ok gateway shim ON for toggle. deploybot, start canary EU 25% at start. if healthy, proceed to 10m 50% and then hold.

deploybot: toggle started at 2025-04-08T11:00:00Z -> EU route 25% to v2 (monitor ml-1725559999).

ops_jordan: first 3m: p50 95ms, p95 180ms, 5xx 0.01% - healthy.

mike: ephemeral issue: a mobile alpha client shows truncated chunked stream when `stream=true`. low volume ~0.005%. logging samples to the bucket.

anya: adding known-issue to the release notes: "mobile alpha: avoid stream=true for now; we will patch SDK".

samir: recommendation: reduce to 5% global and extend eu canary by 15m while mobile patch propagates. also add tenant quarantine: if any tenant > 1% error rate, automatically pin them to v1.

kate: agreed. reduce now and enable tenant-quarantine. deploybot?

deploybot: update: global route -> 5% at 2025-04-08T11:08:12Z. tenant-quarantine enabled with threshold 1% error.

ops_jordan: new metrics: p95 210ms, 5xx 0.03%. mobile truncated rate decreased after shrink. quarantine observed for tenant t-447 -> auto-pinned to v1. logged quarantine event id q-1725559999.

mike: rolling mobile SDK patch to alpha now (v1.1.3-alpha). will report in 25m. once alpha clear, we can plan staged ramp.

kate: rollout decision: hold at 5% for remainder of change window. no auto-ramp. if any global metric breach -> deploybot rollback command below will be used. also update pinlist to include mobile-alpha and t-447 as pinned cohorts.

kate: rollback CLI (ops_jordan pls verify):
```
# emergency rollback
deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --monitor ml-1725559999 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_jordan: verified. alerts wired: slack @eng-oncall + ops-runbook link. will auto-run CLI if thresholds trigger and will notify channel before action.

deploybot: status: partial route 5% to v2 active (ml-1725559999). will execute quarantine and rollback as configured. next check at +15m.

anya: docs: release notes updated and changelog PR opened: https://go/internal/docs/pull/1024. added migration snippet for clients that rely on header-casing.

mike: thumbs-up. i'll post follow-up when mobile alpha stabilizes. :thumbsup: 

kate: thanks team. leaving thread open for updates. if we need to escalate, ping #eng-oncall and tag `rollout:ml-1725559999`.
